rationale: S-0068-05 proposes sweeping Kv3 alone (no Nav1.6) at low / medium / high densities on the deposited Poleg-Polsky DSGC soma to validate that the Kv3 effect (essentially inert in t0067) is a kinetic-model artefact rather than a co-expression artefact. t0074 (channel_tuning_width_bed_a) covers this more cleanly: Kv3 is one of the eight channels swept individually at low / medium / high on the same soma, and the 12-angle tuning-curve protocol (vs t0067's 2-angle PD / ND-only protocol) gives a stricter test of whether Kv3 alone reshapes any aspect of the angle-to-rate response, not just the PD-vs-ND DSI. Rejecting as superseded by the broader t0074 sweep.
